semantic_checklist.reasoning: Joint independence of the sequence is preserved.

semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target assumes IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ for every i.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: Identical distribution with the reference variable is preserved.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The source gives every Xi the common mean μ.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target fixes the reference mean by ∫ X 0 ∂μ = m and assumes identical distribution.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: The common mean is represented faithfully.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The source gives every Xi the common variance σ².
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target assumes Var[X 0; μ] = σ ^ 2 together with identical distribution.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: The common variance is represented faithfully.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The source divides by σ√N and describes unit variance, implicitly requiring nondegeneracy.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: The explicit positivity hypothesis records the source's implicit condition.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The source sums the first positive number N of variables.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target uses Finset.range (N + 1), summing indices 0 through N.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: The zero-based N+1 convention is a cofinal reindexing of positive sample sizes.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The source takes N to infinity.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target uses Filter.atTop on natural numbers.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The source's limiting law is N(0,1).
semantic_checklist.reasoning: The limiting distribution is the standard normal.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The source states pointwise convergence for every real threshold.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target quantifies every t : ℝ and evaluates Set.Iic t.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: Set.Iic gives the CDF event and preserves all-threshold quantification.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The source explains convergence by pointwise convergence of CDF values.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target uses Tendsto of each normalized-sum probability law on Set.Iic t to the standard-normal value.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: The Lean limit is precisely the stated pointwise CDF convergence.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The audited passage explains the meaning of convergence in distribution following the CLT statement.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The declaration is an iff specification of a named convergence predicate.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: It faithfully specifies the source's convergence notion and does not falsely claim to prove the CLT.

lean_implies_source.reasoning: The Lean predicate asserts all-real-threshold CDF convergence of the source-specific i.i.d. normalized sums to the standard normal, with only explicit versions of the source's implicit moment and positivity conditions.

source_implies_lean.reasoning: Under the source's implicit nondegeneracy convention, its normalized-sum pointwise CDF formulation gives the Lean predicate after the cofinal reindexing N to N + 1.

rationale: The repaired declaration faithfully specifies convergence in distribution for the source's normalized sums. It preserves the i.i.d. assumptions, common mean and variance, σ√N normalization, N-to-infinity regime, all-real-threshold CDF formulation, and standard-normal target. The N+1 shift and explicit positivity and L² assumptions formalize indexing and implicit source conditions without changing the claim; this is a definition/specification, not a proof of the central limit theorem.
